name: TRIAERO 冠捷 A9 Pikachu / 105 Di2 R7170
why_interesting: The retained custom-painted A9 card maps to the indexed hand-painted Pikachu Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 option. The frame is well documented, but no exact complete-bike weight or full selected-option BOM was found.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 2x12; exact component-level BOM for the retained option is not exposed
facts.frame: TRIAERO A9 Toray T700 + T800 carbon aero road frame; fork material is unverified
facts.frame_material: Toray T700 + T800 carbon frame; fork and seatpost materials are unverified
facts.frame_construction: Fully internally routed aero carbon chassis with BB86, 12x100 / 12x142 mm thru-axles and an integrated-cockpit frame package
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Fitted tire observation: current exact A9 painted-frame and complete-bike pages specify 700x28C / fits 28 mm; no manufacturer maximum is stated. A conflicting 45 mm collection-page template was rejected as incompatible with the exact product routes
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-frame review describes the A9 as normally stiff rather than excessively stiff, with no lateral-wallow sensation and smooth delay-free acceleration; qualitative whole-bike evidence, not a controlled numeric frame test
